nota: A prova é em inglês: 'f' e 'v' vêm em inglês e 'd' é a tradução, que aparece na bandeira 🇧🇷.

cards.f: How many sides does a TRIANGLE have?
cards.v: 3 sides — and 3 vertices.
cards.d: O triângulo tem 3 lados e 3 vértices.

cards.f: How many sides does a SQUARE have?
cards.v: 4 sides, all the same length — and 4 vertices.
cards.d: O quadrado tem 4 lados iguais e 4 vértices.

cards.f: How is a RECTANGLE different from a square?
cards.v: It has 4 sides too, but 2 are long and 2 are short.
cards.d: O retângulo também tem 4 lados, mas 2 compridos e 2 curtinhos.

cards.f: How many sides does a PENTAGON have?
cards.v: 5 sides — and 5 vertices. Penta means five.
cards.d: O pentágono tem 5 lados e 5 vértices. Penta quer dizer cinco.

cards.f: How many sides does a HEXAGON have?
cards.v: 6 sides — and 6 vertices. Hexa means six.
cards.d: O hexágono tem 6 lados e 6 vértices. Hexa quer dizer seis.

cards.f: How many sides does an OCTAGON have?
cards.v: 8 sides — and 8 vertices. Octo means eight, like an octopus.
cards.d: O octógono tem 8 lados e 8 vértices. Octo quer dizer oito, como o polvo.

cards.f: What is special about the CIRCLE?
cards.v: It is round: no straight sides and 0 vertices.
cards.d: O círculo é redondo: nenhum lado reto e 0 vértices.

cards.f: What is a 2-D figure?
cards.v: A flat figure — you can draw it on paper.
cards.d: Uma figura plana: dá para desenhar no papel.

cards.f: What is a SIDE?
cards.v: One straight line of the figure.
cards.d: O lado: cada linha reta da figura.

cards.f: What is a VERTEX?
cards.v: The corner where two sides meet.
cards.d: O vértice: o cantinho onde dois lados se encontram.

cards.f: What is the plural of VERTEX?
cards.v: Vertices.
cards.d: Vértices. Não existe 'vertexes'.

cards.f: What does EDGE mean?
cards.v: The same as side.
cards.d: Edge quer dizer lado — a mesma coisa que side.

cards.f: The golden rule: in a figure with straight sides…
cards.v: …the number of vertices is the SAME as the number of sides.
cards.d: A regra de ouro: o número de vértices é igual ao de lados.

cards.f: How many vertices does a circle have?
cards.v: Zero. It has no corners at all.
cards.d: Nenhum. Ele não tem cantinho.

cards.f: 3 figures have 13 sides in total. Name one group.
cards.v: Triangle + square + hexagon (3 + 4 + 6 = 13).
cards.d: Triângulo + quadrado + hexágono.

cards.f: 3 figures have 12 vertices in total. Name one group.
cards.v: Square + square + square (4 + 4 + 4 = 12).
cards.d: Quadrado + quadrado + quadrado.

cards.f: A triangle and a square together: how many sides?
cards.v: 7 sides (3 + 4).
cards.d: 7 lados.

cards.f: A book cover looks like a…
cards.v: Rectangle.
cards.d: A capa de um livro parece um retângulo.

cards.f: A door looks like a…
cards.v: Rectangle.
cards.d: Uma porta parece um retângulo.

cards.f: A coin, a plate, a wheel and a clock face look like a…
cards.v: Circle.
cards.d: Moeda, prato, roda e relógio parecem um círculo.

cards.f: A slice of pizza looks like a…
cards.v: Triangle.
cards.d: Uma fatia de pizza parece um triângulo.

cards.f: A party hat looks like a…
cards.v: Triangle.
cards.d: Um chapéu de festa parece um triângulo.

cards.f: A stop sign looks like an…
cards.v: Octagon — 8 sides.
cards.d: Uma placa de PARE parece um octógono, de 8 lados.

cards.f: A honeycomb cell looks like a…
cards.v: Hexagon — 6 sides.
cards.d: Um favo de mel parece um hexágono, de 6 lados.

cards.f: The black patch on a soccer ball looks like a…
cards.v: Pentagon — 5 sides.
cards.d: O gomo preto da bola parece um pentágono, de 5 lados.

cards.f: When does a figure have SYMMETRY?
cards.v: When you can fold it and the two halves match.
cards.d: Quando dá para dobrar e as duas metades combinam.

cards.f: What is the LINE OF SYMMETRY?
cards.v: The fold line. It can be standing up or lying down.
cards.d: A linha da dobra. Pode ser em pé ou deitada.

cards.f: What is the MATCHING PART?
cards.v: The half that is missing — the mirror image of the other half.
cards.d: A metade que falta: a imagem no espelho da outra metade.

cards.f: What is a MIRA?
cards.v: The little red mirror we use to check symmetry.
cards.d: O espelhinho vermelho que usamos para conferir a simetria.

cards.f: Can a figure have more than one line of symmetry?
cards.v: Yes. The letter O has one standing up AND one lying down.
cards.d: Pode. A letra O tem uma em pé e outra deitada.

cards.f: Which letters have symmetry?
cards.v: O, X, A, M, V, C and B.
cards.d: O, X, A, M, V, C e B.

cards.f: Which letters have NO symmetry?
cards.v: G, P, J and R.
cards.d: G, P, J e R.

cards.f: The letters C and B: where is their line of symmetry?
cards.v: Lying down (horizontal) — not standing up!
cards.d: Deitada! Quem só procura a linha em pé erra essas duas.

cards.f: Where do you put the Mira on the word MOM?
cards.v: Standing up, in the middle of the O.
cards.d: Em pé, no meio do O.

cards.f: Name another word with symmetry.
cards.v: WOW, MUM, TOT or TOOT.
cards.d: WOW, MUM, TOT ou TOOT.

cards.f: What happens in a SLIDE?
cards.v: The figure walks to the next spot. It does not spin and it does not mirror.
cards.d: A figura anda para o lugar de perto, sem girar e sem espelhar.

cards.f: What happens in a FLIP?
cards.v: The figure shows its mirror image.
cards.d: A figura vira e mostra a imagem no espelho.

cards.f: What happens in a TURN?
cards.v: The figure spins around a point, like a clock hand.
cards.d: A figura roda em volta de um pontinho, como o ponteiro do relógio.

cards.f: What is a REPEATING PATTERN?
cards.v: A little piece that comes again and again, always in the same order.
cards.d: Um pedacinho que se repete, sempre na mesma ordem.

cards.f: How many different figures do you need for the quilt border pattern?
cards.v: Just one — you slide it, flip it or turn it.
cards.d: Uma só: é ela que desliza, vira ou gira.

cards.f: After a slide, a flip or a turn, what STAYS THE SAME?
cards.v: The number of sides, the number of vertices, the size and the name of the figure.
cards.d: O número de lados, o de vértices, o tamanho e o nome da figura.

cards.f: After a slide, a flip or a turn, what CAN CHANGE?
cards.v: Where the figure is, and which way it faces.
cards.d: Onde a figura está e para que lado ela aponta.

cards.f: A triangle turns. Is it still a triangle?
cards.v: Yes — still 3 sides and 3 vertices.
cards.d: Continua sendo: ainda 3 lados e 3 vértices.

cards.f: How big is the quilt grid?
cards.v: 3 by 3 — nine blocks, numbered 1 to 9.
cards.d: 3 por 3: nove blocos, numerados de 1 a 9.

cards.f: Which block has only a pentagon?
cards.v: Block 3.
cards.d: O bloco 3.

cards.f: You draw a triangle on each edge of the pentagon. What does it look like?
cards.v: A star.
cards.d: Uma estrela.

cards.f: Which blocks have the same design?
cards.v: Blocks 1 and 9 · blocks 2 and 6 · blocks 4 and 8. Only the colours change.
cards.d: 1 e 9 · 2 e 6 · 4 e 8. Só as cores mudam.

cards.f: Start in block 1: down two, one right, up one, one left. Where are you?
cards.v: Block 4.
cards.d: No bloco 4.
